text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon's remarkable resilience
during the Battle of the Dorms
sticks in my
mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curious how her running ability compares,
I make my way to the track
in hopes of
observing her performance during training.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right, lookin' good! But I know you've
got more where that came
from!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You mentioned before about a rival you
wanna defeat, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Then let that fire inside you burn even
brighter!

text_block_list.name: Miho Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am! Will do!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I arrive to see her training alongside
one of
the younger students.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Good,
then it's time for another lap! Let's
do this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Amazon's footwork is dynamic and
powerful as she speeds around the
track.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Go, go, gooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although her positioning leaves something
to be desired, she
manages to seize the
lead by sheer force of will.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I find myself drawn to her fearless
style of
running, which seems to be
a direct
reflection of her personality itself.

text_block_list.name: Miho Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much, Hishiama! I can't wait to train with you again!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You bet! Must be dog-tired, huh? Make
sure to eat a good meal, and
take a nice,
hot bath afterwards.

text_block_list.name: Miho Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am! See you next time!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Careful, now! Don't want any tumbles!

Heh... Her expression's really toughened
up.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, it won't be long before she
turns into a formidable rival in
her own
right!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Who're you?
Oh, a badge. So you're
a trainer at the school?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: And I don't just sound like it— I am having fun! There's nothin' better than seeing the youngsters get stronger right before my eyes!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
After all,
that just means I'll have my pick
of opponents to race
one-on-one!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hoo boy, this is exactly why Tracen Academy is the best! There are super strong Umamusume everywhere you look!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And I'm gonna take 'em all on and get
even stronger myself! I'll go one-on-one
against everyone in the Twinkle Series
if I
have to!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: That's just how I roll!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
True to her words, Amazon spends her
days competing against
practically every
Umamusume she crosses paths with.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Time for a one-on-one, Fuji! This time,
let's see who can hold their
breath longer
underwater!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, that sounds like a rather risky
endeavor... Hey, I know! What say we
include a rule that you're allowed to make
your opponent
laugh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You little trickster... But sure,
I'm cool with
it! You know me—I never
shy away from a
challenge!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Cough, cough! Huff, puff... Damn you, Fuji! Resorting to tickling? That's playin' dirty!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Your sides are too easy a target
to resist.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Hold up, Biko. Think you could
repeat that?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I said—let's have a hero pose showdown,
Hishiama! We'll see which of
us is more
like an ally of justice!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Not sure I get it,
but if we're talkin'
a one-on-one, then I'm all
in!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Like this? Hup! Hngh! Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Whew... Oh, fancy seeing you again.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well,
tryouts are just around the corner. I
can't be lazing around when
my big
debut's on the line.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I gotta show off my skills during the race
and get myself a trainer with
a fiery spirit!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Like I said before, it's not enough going
one-on-one with students here at the
school. I gotta throw down with the
Twinkle Series crowd
too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Well, can you blame me at a
school like this?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
But I guess I kinda get it from my mom
too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Sure did! She only ever competed overseas
though. Yep, that's
right—you wouldn't
know it, but I used to live abroad too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
My mom was pretty big over there, I'll
have you know. I really looked
up to
her—that's part of what got me into
racing.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
But the first time I experienced a race
firsthand was when I came to
Japan to
watch the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I'll never forget the thrill of watching
those
crazy speed demons
battle it out!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I was all, "Whoa, awesome! Lemme at 'em! I wanna go one-on-one with those badasses!" And I leapt right out of my seat!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Nah, my mom grabbed me by the
scruff of the neck and sat me
right back
down.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Boy, was she pissed. It's fun thinking back on the race and all, but I'd rather not remember that part.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems the excitement and longing for
the world of competition that
she felt back
then made Amazon who she is today.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what's this?
Didja fall prey to my wily
charms just now, hmm?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
But I've got bad news for ya!
I'm not gonna
let myself be scouted 'til
after tryouts.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: There's no rule against it or anything, but that's what I've decided. I want you and the other trainers to witness what I can do in a real race.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Mark my words—you're gonna see
somethin' real special!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What sort of running will this go-getter
show us at tryouts? I can't wait
to find out.
